eu5ab_location_combined_pop_promotion_speed = {
	value = modifier:local_pop_promotion_speed
	owner = { add = modifier:global_pop_promotion_speed }
	add = {
		value = modifier:local_pop_promotion_speed_scaled
		multiply = population
	}
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		owner = { add = modifier:global_pop_promotion_speed_modifier }
		add = modifier:local_pop_promotion_speed_modifier
	}
}

# Vanilla rgo_level adds a fixed workforce demand to every raw material.
# Laborers always qualify; unemployed slaves count only when the owner
# has the vanilla country modifier that lets slaves work RGOs.
eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion = {
	value = 1
}

eu5ab_rgo_current_available_workers = {
	value = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:laborers)"
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { modifier:allow_rgo_slave_demand = yes } }
		add = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:slaves)"
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_promotion_source_pool = {
	value = 0
	add = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:peasants)"
}

eu5ab_rgo_projected_promotion = {
	value = eu5ab_location_combined_pop_promotion_speed
	multiply = 1.5
	multiply = owner.var:eu5ab_global_job_fill_deadline_months
	max = eu5ab_rgo_promotion_source_pool
}

eu5ab_rgo_projected_available_workers = {
	value = eu5ab_rgo_current_available_workers
	add = eu5ab_rgo_projected_promotion
}

eu5ab_rgo_labor_risk_penalty = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			owner.var:eu5ab_global_pause_low_workforce <= 0
			NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_projected_workforce_sufficient = yes }
		}
		add = {
			value = eu5ab_rgo_projected_available_workers
			subtract = eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion
			divide = eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion
			multiply = 1200
			min = -1200
			max = 0
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		multiply = 0.5
	}
}

eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers = {
	value = eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers
	add = eu5ab_candidate_projected_promotion
}

eu5ab_workforce_prediction_available = {
	value = 1
}

eu5ab_labor_risk_penalty = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_pause_low_workforce <= 0
			NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_projected_workforce_sufficient = yes }
		}
		add = {
			value = eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers
			subtract = eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs
			divide = eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs
			multiply = 1200
			min = -1200
			max = 0
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_universal_need_score > 0 }
		multiply = 0.5
	}
}

eu5ab_labor_result_code = {
	value = 3 # 1 current, 2 fills inside horizon, 3 still short
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_current_workforce_sufficient = yes }
		subtract = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_projected_workforce_sufficient = yes }
		subtract = 1
	}
}

eu5ab_market_books_projected_construction_overage = {
	value = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:books)"
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_books|scope:eu5ab_material_market)"
	}
	add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_books
	subtract = {
		value = "market.goods_supply_in_market(goods:books)"
		multiply = eu5ab_construction_shortage_factor
	}
}

eu5ab_market_marble_projected_construction_overage = {
	value = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:marble)"
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_marble
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_marble target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_marble|scope:eu5ab_material_market)"
	}
	add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_marble
	subtract = {
		value = "market.goods_supply_in_market(goods:marble)"
		multiply = eu5ab_construction_shortage_factor
	}
}

eu5ab_market_tools_projected_construction_overage = {
	value = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:tools)"
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_tools
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_tools target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_tools|scope:eu5ab_material_market)"
	}
	add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_tools
	subtract = {
		value = "market.goods_supply_in_market(goods:tools)"
		multiply = eu5ab_construction_shortage_factor
	}
}

	divide = 100

	divide = 100

# Current RGO utilization is workers divided by built capacity, not by
# the location's theoretical geological maximum.
eu5ab_rgo_current_capacity = {
	value = rgo_level
	min = 1
}

eu5ab_rgo_utilization_ratio = {
	value = rgo_workers
	divide = eu5ab_rgo_current_capacity
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

eu5ab_rgo_candidate_score = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { is_full_expanded_rgo = no }
		add = 80
	}
	add = {
		value = eu5ab_rgo_utilization_ratio
		multiply = 100
	}
	add = eu5ab_rgo_labor_risk_penalty
	add = -100
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_consecutive_rgo_expansions }
		add = {
			value = var:eu5ab_consecutive_rgo_expansions
			multiply = -140
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			raw_material = goods:beer
			market ?= {
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:beer)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:beer)"
					multiply = 0.9
				}
			}
		}
		add = 320
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			raw_material = goods:beer
			market ?= {
				"market_price(goods:beer)" > {
					value = "default_price(goods:beer)"
					multiply = 1.25
				}
			}
		}
		add = 140
	}

# Cross-feature priority comes from the ordered CMM list. This score only
# combines general location need with RGO-specific need inside the RGO class.
eu5ab_rgo_queue_order_score = {
	value = eu5ab_location_need_score
	add = eu5ab_rgo_candidate_score
}

eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve = {
	value = owner.var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve
}

# RGO queues are the civil queue entries not attached to a building type.
eu5ab_rgos_under_construction = {
	value = num_civil_constructions
	every_buildings_in_location = { subtract = building_levels_under_construction }
}

eu5ab_rgo_cash_required = {
	value = 100
	add = eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve
}
